clips.title: The story
paras: Garren's Haunt is an abandoned farmstead nestled in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a prosperous human homestead, the farm fell to ruin when the Scourge wiped out the Garren family, leaving the overgrown grounds overrun by feral Rot Hide gnolls.

Before the Third War, this farmstead supported a family and produced bountiful harvests under the Kingdom of Lordaeron. When the Plague of Undeath swept across the countryside, the Scourge descended upon the farm and slaughtered Garren and his kin. Today, the fields lie gray and withered, the farmhouse and barn decaying under the perpetual gloom of Tirisfal.
